summary: @servicetitan/folder-lint preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated 727KB Bun-CJS payload
details: The package's declared purpose is a small ESLint folder-schema helper, but package.json defines a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh GitHub releases (architecture-selected zip), extracts it, chmod +x's the binary, and then execFileSync's the Bun binary against a bundled math_init.js. math_init.js is a single-line 727KB file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` using a rotated numeric/string-array decoder (`n7gIxM` + `WV8StW`) and `with` statements — a format specifically unparseable by Node's strict mode, so it can only run under the freshly-downloaded Bun runtime. setup.mjs itself is obfuscator.io-style renamed (`_0x488df8`, `_0x19328d.YCZJE`, per-function property lookup tables) hiding OS detection (`/etc/os-release`, musl/Alpine checks), the download URL construction, unzip, and exec. Fetching an alternate JS runtime at install time solely to execute a heavily obfuscated bundled payload has no relationship to the package's stated ESLint helper purpose and is the canonical alternate-runtime-dropper pattern used to evade Node-based supply-chain scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
